== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Wedge Antilles (Japanese)|Wedge Antilles]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/135901786/HFWQ7_jt-0CZpx7H4aMiFQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 71262995.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>768294934d1e7f2f24ea5f09a0716c7828828fa260bbdc1c2ee8f212276c1a09</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
